final: {"prompt":"A purely nonrepresentational abstract painting that evokes cognition as a shifting interplay of possibility, constraint, revision, and unresolved space. Square composition, painting extending edge to edge. A deep ultramarine field holds uneven masses of smoky violet and near-black, interrupted by thin washes of translucent celadon. Concentrate the greatest density slightly off-center: restless vermilion strokes, scraped ivory ridges, and small eruptions of acidic yellow overlap, interrupt, and partially obscure one another. Let gestures begin decisively and dissolve into dry-brush hesitation; let buried colors reappear through scumbled surfaces. Repeat a few irregular rhythms with subtle variations, never forming a grid or diagram. Set thick impasto against nearly bare, luminous passages. Broad areas of quiet pale gray-green create spatial tension around the compressed activity, while a few isolated dark strokes pull attention toward the edges. Convey multiplicity without a central narrator, coherence continually forming and loosening, precision beside ambiguity. Visceral pigment, visible bristle marks, rubbed stains, palette-knife abrasion, layered opacity and translucency. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No frame, wall, room, or gallery setting; only the square painting filling the entire image."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
